title: King Sebastian of Portugal dies at Alcacer Quibir
summary: A Portuguese crusading army was annihilated by the Moroccan Saadi army near Ksar el-Kebir. Three kings died, including the young Sebastian of Portugal.
reason: Sebastian backed a deposed Moroccan sultan, Abu Abdallah, against his uncle Abd al-Malik in hope of a North African crusade.
significance: Sebastian died without heir, which led to Spain taking the Portuguese crown in 1580, while Morocco gained new prestige.
